full_page.content:
Page 143 Cont.
May 11th Lewis Mather - 64 - (Nine Mile Telegraph) asthma and heart ... . never joined any church. . . Methodist mother ... fed him up on religion, etc.
Glen Snyder - 32 - lutheran, neglecting wife and babies for some- one outside the family; now working to divorce Catholic wife.
Page 144
May 12th John Preston - 45 - asthma and fearful sinus; has to struggle day after day to support wife and five children ..... Enrolled
May 12th Mrs. Alice Tyrrell - 56 - of Lansing - intestinal tumor - operation last October - not well ever since - here To-day with husband and sister.
14 Joan Iwanecki - 22 - blind and mentally weak .... Enrolled ...
Mrs. Wilfred A. Rocheleau - 39 - has quite a family - husband and five - severe asthma. Enrolled To-day in Ser. Masses - Lately found to have inward goitre.
Frank J. Ryan - 61 - Ypsilanti Hosp. - seriously mental.
15 Lawrence Sullivan - 46 - of Wabash, Indiana - fears he has lost his faith.
Ascension Tomorrow - great Novena.
Page 145 May 18 John A. Ratcliffe - 25 - convert. Serious condition of Kidney - only one left. Wife phoned several time .... finally after a month in "Mayo Clynic" - unconscious for two weeks ... Mother promises if son is spared she'll take instructions to be Catholic. Next a.m. patient was conscious - is here To-day still weak .... was enrolled frequently.
21 E'd McNalley - 36 - of Garden City, Mich. - blood-tumor at birth has grown slowly but of late has caused trouble; was told if broken would cause death before he could get to hospital. Last Sunday morn- ing it broke - blood gushing forth; wife who is convert rushed to get cloth to stop it and at same time awoke the four children to pray for Papa. Bleeding was practically stopped when she got back to husband's side.
Mildred Manley - 22- presbiterian - Husband Cath. - inward cancer Ex- pects to go to Hospital soon.
